roles.title: Roles
roles.note: Eight roles ship with HirePilotX and cannot be deleted. Duplicate one to build your own.

descriptions.owner: Runs the agency. Everything, including billing and ownership.
descriptions.admin: Manages people and workspace configuration. Not payment details.
descriptions.accountManager: Owns a book of clients — renewals, fees and account health.
descriptions.profileLead: Leads a desk end to end — reviews what recruiters submit.
descriptions.recruiter: Works assigned jobs and submits candidates for approval.
descriptions.sourcer: Sourcing only. Cannot submit, reject, or see money.
descriptions.hiringManager: The internal quality gate. Reviews before a client sees it.
descriptions.client: Client portal only. Sees and approves their own submissions.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.subtitle: Tick a box to grant. Delete implies edit and view — HirePilotX keeps those in step for you.
matrix.customSubtitle: Custom role. Tick a box to grant; delete implies edit and view.
matrix.ownerNote: Owner is fixed. It always holds every permission — that is what makes it the account of last resort, and why it cannot be edited or deleted.
matrix.systemNote: {{role}} ships with HirePilotX. You can adjust its permissions, but it cannot be deleted. To diverge substantially, duplicate it instead — upgrades may add new resources to system roles.
matrix.emptyBody: Try the module name as it appears in the sidebar — Jobs, Candidates, Clients.

tips.forced: {{column}} is required by another permission on {{resource}}
tips.scope: Own = their records · Team = their desk · All = the whole workspace
tips.scopeNone: {{resource}} is workspace-wide — there is nothing to scope

summary.title: Permission summary
summary.subtitle: What {{role}} will be able to do once saved.
summary.reachableNote: Modules that appear in their sidebar.
summary.destructiveNote: Deletion is the permission to audit first.
summary.noAccessBody: Those modules will not appear in the sidebar for anyone holding this role.
summary.deleteBand: Deleting {{role}} moves its {{members}} to the role you nominate. The role itself cannot be recovered.

savebar.note: {{changes}} to {{role}} · applies immediately to {{members}} when saved

members.subtitle: {{shown}} of {{total}} shown · the rest are on the users screen

save.title: Apply {{changes}} to {{role}}?
save.blurb: Changes apply immediately to all {{members}} with this role. Anyone signed in now will see their access change without reloading.

create.title: New role
create.blurb: Custom roles can be edited and deleted. Start from an existing role if you only need a small variation.
create.blankDetail: No permissions. You grant every one deliberately.
create.copyDetail: Copies all {{count}} permissions and their record scopes from {{role}}.

duplicate.title: Duplicate {{role}}
duplicate.blurb: Copies every permission and scope from {{role}}. The copy is a custom role, so you can change or delete it freely.

delete.title: Delete {{role}}?
delete.typeFirst: Type the role name to confirm
delete.moves: Everyone holding it moves to {{role}}, the closest system role. Nobody is locked out.
delete.audited: The change is recorded in the audit log against your name.
delete.irreversible: The role and its permission set cannot be recovered.

toast.createdSub: {{role}} is ready — assign it from user management
toast.failedSub: Nothing changed. Try again, or reload the page.
